LESSON: CLEANING NOSE

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Cleaning nose
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cleaning nose, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we clean our nose? 2. Why do we clean the nose?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Cleaning nose together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Responsibility: self-drive as learner improvises a handkerchief.

● Respect: etiquette as learner discusses using signs the importance of cleaning the nose using a clean handkerchief

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Human Sexuality: Health and wellness - Learners observe personal hygiene as they clean their nose.

Link to other learning areas: The learner is able to relate the use of a clean handkerchief to clean the nose as a way of taking care

of self in Religious activities.

Suggested Assessment Methods

Observation, Oral- aural and signed questions,peer assessment, self assessment, written assessment.

Suggested Resources

water, handkerchief, pictures depicting cleaning of the nose, pieces of clean old clothes, video clips, relevant digital devices.
